$comment: Slot -> source art. design/00-DESIGN-SYSTEM.md §2.4 is the classification protocol.
mood: blue = effort, gold = evidence, boss = BOSS surfaces only.
focal: CSS object-position — keeps the figure clear of the copy.
text: true means the plate carries its own baked-in tagline, so the screen
must not overlay a competing one (§2.4 rule 4).
A slot with source null renders a procedural gradient instead; every screen
must look finished with zero art present.
Re-run `npm run art` after editing this file.

boot.note: Lit-eye portrait. Quiet enough to sit under the wordmark.

start-hero.note: Carries DISCIPLINE CREATES FREEDOM / A BETTER YOU AWAITS. The promise.

today.note: Bleeds from the top-right corner only, under a directional scrim.

level-up.note: Ascending a staircase toward a colossus. DISCIPLINE TODAY / A GREATER YOU TOMORROW.
level-up.$zoomNote: zoom is the default crop scale for this plate. Several plates carry their own lettering down a margin; a phone viewport is narrower than the source aspect, so cover-cropping slices that text mid-word. Zooming pushes it cleanly out of frame. Set here rather than at each call site so a plate cannot be used wrongly by a new screen.

rank.note: Reaching for the eclipse. HIGHER THAN YESTERDAY. Rank is evidence, so gold.

checkpoint.note: The cliff at sunrise. The report screen — the one that says something changed.

training.note: Full physique under banners that map body parts to attributes — CHEST BUILDS CONFIDENCE, BACK BUILDS STRENGTH, ABS BUILDS SELF CONTROL, LEGS BUILDS RESILIENCE. The app's own attribute model in a picture.

review.note: The nightly climb. Evening review header.

review-weekly.note: A BRIGHTER YOU SOMEDAY. The weekly distance-travelled block.

boss.note: Landscape banner, 1945x808. NEXT LEVEL AWAITS. The BossList header.

boss-cleared.note: Enthroned. Gold, not red — clearing a boss is evidence, and the plate agrees.

quote.note: Seated, resting, looking out. Contemplative rather than flexing — sits far back behind a quote card at low opacity.

overflow.$comment: Classified but not yet slotted. Kept here so nothing is lost and a later screen can claim one without re-reviewing the folder.
